results.title: Engineering briefs for AI training
results.description: Hashlist's Data Operations Platform (DOP) hosts engineering briefs where embedded, hardware, and controls engineers write problems that current AI models get wrong. Contributors package real projects — with datasheets, source code, logs, and tools — into environments on the platform, then create tasks with reference answers and naive answers scored against hidden marking scripts.

results.title: New creative roles
results.description: Hashlist opened 3 new roles focused on 3D design, 3D modeling, and video editing. These roles involve recording yourself completing a finished scene, model, or video in tools like Blender, Maya, or DaVinci Resolve while explaining each step — a shift from its earlier embedded-engineering focus.

results.title: Earlier briefs
results.description: Six briefs were opened covering driver and peripheral bring-up, hardware and electrical design, PLC control logic, real-time timing budgets, sensor configuration faults, and general embedded systems.
